items.label: Myosin II regulatory domain
items.plain: Two light chains wrap around a short segment of the myosin II heavy-chain neck. The resolved region measures 63 residues on the heavy-chain construct. The motor head and tail lie outside this structure.

structures.title: Physarum polycephalum myosin II regulatory domain

items.label: Fragmin P domains
items.plain: The F2 and F3 domains of the actin-binding protein fragmin P are shown together. The related depositions capture different ion conditions.

items.label: Actin–fragmin F1 complex
items.plain: The reference crystal pairs the F1 domain of Physarum fragmin with chicken skeletal actin. Other deposits include human actin. The structures show how the isolated domain binds actin.

items.label: Actin–fragmin kinase
items.plain: The resolved catalytic domain belongs to a kinase that phosphorylates actin in the actin–fragmin complex.

structures.title: ACTIN-FRAGMIN KINASE, CATALYTIC DOMAIN FROM PHYSARUM POLYCEPHALUM

items.label: Calcium-binding protein CBP40
items.plain: CBP40, also called LAV1-2, forms aggregates in the presence of calcium at sites of damage to the plasmodium. This assembly is the metal-free construct. The calcium-bound structure is also listed.

structures.title: METAL-FREE STRUCTURE OF MULTIDOMAIN EF-HAND PROTEIN, CBP40, FROM TRUE SLIME MOLD
CA2+-BOUND STRUCTURE OF MULTIDOMAIN EF-HAND PROTEIN, CBP40, FROM TRUE SLIME MOLD

items.label: Haemagglutinin I
items.plain: A lectin from Physarum. The deposited assembly contains two copies of the same protein chain.

structures.title: Crystal structure of hemagglutinin

items.label: Spherulin-3A
items.plain: A βγ-crystallin family protein associated with the spherule stage. The surface shows the four-chain assembly assigned to the crystal structure. A solution NMR entry is also listed.

structures.title: Evolution of the eye lens beta-gamma-crystallin domain fold
NMR STRUCTURE OF SPHERULIN 3A (S3A) FROM PHYSARUM POLYCEPHALUM, MINIMIZED AVERAGE STRUCTURE

items.label: NADH–cytochrome b5 reductase
items.plain: This flavoprotein transfers electrons from NADH to cytochrome b5. The surface includes both protein chains in the deposited dimer.

structures.title: The Structure of Physarum polycephalum cytochrome b5 reductase

items.label: Homing endonuclease I-PpoI
items.plain: This Physarum endonuclease is deposited in several experimental complexes with nucleic acids. The reference assembly shows two protein chains and four DNA strands.
